overall_goal: Wash the dishes, clean up the workspace, and resume cooking

goals.description: Scrub the spoon, plate, and bowl with a sponge
goals.rationale: The person applies dishwashing liquid to a sponge and scrubs the first few dirty dishes in the sink.

goals.description: Scrub the cup, knife, and chopping board with a sponge
goals.rationale: The person continues the washing process by scrubbing the cup, knife, and chopping board.

goals.description: Rinse the chopping board and put away clean utensils
goals.rationale: The person rinses the chopping board under running water and organizes previously washed utensils into their respective stands and drawers.

goals.description: Rinse the cup, plate, and bowl under running water
goals.rationale: The person turns on the tap and rinses the scrubbed cup, plate, and bowl, placing them in the crockery tray.

goals.description: Scrub the jar and its lid with a sponge
goals.rationale: The person opens a jar, applies more dishwashing liquid to the sponge, and scrubs the jar and its lid.

goals.description: Scrub the spoon, bowl, and plate with a sponge
goals.rationale: The person finishes scrubbing the remaining dirty dishes, including a spoon, bowl, and plate.

goals.description: Rinse the plate, bowl, spoons, knife, and lid under running water
goals.rationale: The person turns the tap back on and rinses the next batch of scrubbed dishes, placing them in the drying tray.

goals.description: Rinse the bowl, spoon, and jar under running water
goals.rationale: The person rinses the final batch of dishes, briefly re-scrubbing a spoon before placing everything in the crockery tray.

goals.description: Wash and dry hands, and wipe the tabletop
goals.rationale: The person uses hand wash to clean their hands, then uses a tablecloth to wipe the tabletop and dry their hands.

goals.description: Retrieve a plastic box from the cabinet
goals.rationale: The person opens the cabinet, takes out a plastic box with its lid, and places it on the tabletop.

goals.description: Mix the contents of the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person picks up a spatula and stirs the food cooking in the frying pan.
